segments.title: Cold Open & Station Sign-On
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the official broadcast sign-on and countdown from the executive producer station.

segments.title: Pre-Show Banter & Gerni Championships Discovery
segments.notes: Case and Kendall discuss new intro graphics and the existence of the Gurning World Championships while the stream boots up.

segments.title: Hype Train: Gooning Freestyle
segments.notes: Hype Train commandeers the feed with a high-tempo gooning-themed freestyle rap over eclectic beats, acknowledging subscriber milestones.

segments.title: Gurning World Championships Coverage
segments.notes: Case and Rick review the 2024 World Gurning Championship in Egremont, Cumbria, analyzing competitor faces and attempting their own gurns.

segments.title: Middle East Escalation: Israel-Hezbollah Conflict
segments.notes: Case and Rick cover Israeli airstrikes on Beirut, the death of a senior Hezbollah commander, and the UN Security Council meeting, using a color-coded threat meter.

segments.title: Pepito Interlude: Golf Ball Diet
segments.notes: Pepito claims to have eaten a bucket of stolen driving-range golf balls, describing them as negative-calorie 'hard popcorn'.

segments.title: Trailer Thursday: Panda Plan, Hell Is Us, Monster Hunter Wilds
segments.notes: Case and Pepito react to the Jackie Chan panda-action film trailer, a ghost-horror game (Hell Is Us), and the Monster Hunter Wilds reveal.

segments.title: AI-Discovered Nazca Geoglyphs
segments.notes: Case and Jeff Ripple examine 303 new Nazca Lines identified by AI, including a knife-wielding orca, decapitation scenes, and chat-suggested genital slit and Wreck-It Ralph glyphs.

segments.title: Jeremy Pizzagate: Cheesy 3D Film Director Interview
segments.notes: Case interviews Jeremy Pizzagate, director of 'Talking Weights' and the 'Nightmare Fuel' oil-barrel saga, who claims his father inspired the Dick Tracy villain Pizza Face.

segments.title: How To with Jeb: Cinnamon-Sugar Pancakes, AR Proposals & Screaming Viking
segments.notes: Jeb and his wood-trapped father demonstrate marriage-inducing pancakes, an AR Catwoman proposal filter, and the Cheers-derived Screaming Viking cocktail, which wins a flash poll to become the official BIN network drink.

segments.title: Munch & Crum: Suit Jackets, Jorts vs. Fanny Packs, Gurn-Off
segments.notes: Munch and Crum debut new red and blue jackets, debate George vs. fanny packs and jorts, then engage in a live gurning contest judged by chat.

segments.title: DJ Newsic: Trump Nail-Salon Conspiracy & Thumb Rap
segments.notes: DJ Newsic auto-tunes a segment on Trump sharing a nail-tech cousin conspiracy about paid Kamala Harris protesters, then freestyles as a sentient thumb over a conspiracy trap beat.

segments.title: Raid Outro
segments.notes: Case thanks supporters and raids Jeremy the prop guy's World of Warcraft stream.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchored the full broadcast, managed segment transitions, and participated in gurning and trailer reactions.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivered cold-open sign-on, debuted a new gray jacket, and claimed to have eaten a bucket of golf balls.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Walked through frame during pre-show and trailer segments, prompting Case to hide her with a Boglan puppet.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: recurring. Hijacked the early broadcast with a gooning-themed freestyle rap acknowledging 19-month sub Metal Chaos and other supporters.

characters.name: Rick
characters.notes: correspondent. Co-anchored Gurning and Middle East coverage, attempted gurning faces, and read a color-coded threat meter.

characters.name: Munch
characters.notes: debate analyst. Debuted a red jacket, won the gurning poll, and claimed to drink a gallon of salt water nightly for low stomach salinity.

characters.name: Crum
characters.notes: debate analyst. Wore a new blue jacket, argued for jorts over fanny packs, and lost the gurning poll to Munch.

characters.name: Jeb Nogget
characters.notes: recurring. Broadcast from his woodshop with his board-trapped father, shared a pancake recipe, an AR proposal idea, and the Screaming Viking cocktail.

characters.name: DJ Newsic
characters.notes: recurring. Closed the show with an auto-tuned nail-conspiracy segment and a sentient-thumb freestyle over a conspiracy trap beat.

characters.name: Jeremy Pizzagate
characters.notes: guest. Cheesy 3D film director interviewed about his 'Talking Weights' and 'Nightmare Fuel' franchises and his Pizza Face namesake.

lore_notes.fact: Pepito debuted a new gray/white jacket to differentiate from Case.
Pepito claims to eat stolen driving-range golf balls as a negative-calorie snack.
The Screaming Viking (vodka, vermouth, lime, celery, cucumber) won a flash poll to become the official BIN network cocktail.
Munch and Crum each received new suit jackets (red and blue respectively).
Munch claims a doctor (Captain Phillips) prescribed a gallon of salt water before bed for low stomach salinity.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News opened with a gooning-derailed Hype Train before pivoting to the Gurning World Championships and the escalating Israel-Hezbollah conflict, complete with a condiment-based threat meter. The broadcast then veered through trailer reactions, AI-discovered Nazca geoglyphs, a cheesy 3D-director interview, and Jeb's woodshop cooking segment that crowned the Screaming Viking as the network's official drink. Munch and Crum debuted matching jackets for a debate on jorts versus fanny packs that devolved into a live gurn-off, and DJ Newsic closed with a thumb-persona freestyle on Trump's nail-salon conspiracy before raiding a prop-maker's WoW stream.
